content_data.meeting_title: Strategic AI Integration Steering Committee - Phase 1 Review
agenda_items: Assessment of initial ROI and impact on production efficiency
Discussion on vendor selection for enterprise-wide AI platform
Roadmap planning for Phase 2: Pilot expansion and new use case validation
Identification of key risks and mitigation strategies for scaling AI
Review of Phase 1 AI PoC outcomes in manufacturing operations

Approved transition of successful AI PoC modules to pilot phase within two manufacturing plants.
Established a cross-functional AI governance working group to standardize data protocols.
